text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Curren Chan's plan is to get her UmaTube channel up and running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition to this and her already very active Umastagram, she also plans on posting extensively on Umatok and Umatter from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I help her take pictures and videos for her socials, I realize just how difficult of a task it all is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain my concerns for her fatigue levels, but… she brushes them aside and continues working hard to spread her cuteness.
